messages.subject: Drag and drop file uploading
parts:
Hi,
I would love to be able to upload files by dragging them onto the application. Is this possible in some way?
Thanks,
Florian

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Drag and drop file uploading
parts:
It isn't currently a feature, but it could certainly be done (it would be an alternate front-end for the current file upload control). Currently you could use fileInput and drag the file onto the file input field, that works but isn't as nice as having a big drop target which I imagine is what you had in mind.

Feel free to file a feature request at https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues
